name: purgewave

scripts.dist: npm install --no-save --os=win32 --cpu=x64 sharp && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:local: npm install --no-save --os=win32 --cpu=x64 sharp && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --dir && rm -rf PurgeWave-win && cp -r release/win-unpacked PurgeWave-win && echo 'Updated PurgeWave-win/ in the project root.'

description: A Windows desktop app for triaging a local music library one track at a time.
